description: Fetch a USGS pre-computed real-time earthquake feed by magnitude tier and time window. These feeds are CDN-cached by USGS and faster and more available than the query API — use them for "what's happening now" queries. "all" includes microseisms (M<1); "significant" is a USGS curation based on magnitude, felt reports, and PAGER impact estimates. "hour" returns 0–10 events typically; "month" can exceed 10,000 for the "all" tier, so results are returned a page at a time: count is the page size, totalCount the whole feed, and nextCursor the input for the following page. Each page returns limit events (default 15, at most 1,000), fewer only on the last page. The cursor is opaque and must be passed back verbatim — unlike earthquake_search_events, these feeds retain the first-read generation for up to 15 minutes, subject to capacity eviction and restart. An expired cursor requires a fresh first read. For historical or filtered queries, use earthquake_search_events instead.

cursor.description: Opaque token for the next page, taken verbatim from a previous call's nextCursor. Omit for the first page. Do not construct, parse, or edit it — it encodes a position in the feed snapshot and is rejected if malformed.

limit.description: Events to return per page. Default 15; a larger value returns at most 1,000 and says so. Applies to the first page; later pages carry the page size inside the cursor and ignore limit, so set it on the first call.

magnitude_tier.description: Minimum magnitude threshold for the feed. "all" includes microseisms (M<1). "1.0" is M1.0+. "2.5" is M2.5+. "4.5" is M4.5+. "significant" is a USGS curated selection based on magnitude, felt reports, and PAGER impact estimates — not purely magnitude-based.

time_window.description: Time window for the feed. "hour" typically returns 0–10 events; "month" can exceed 10,000 for the "all" tier. Prefer "hour" or "day" for real-time status checks.

name: earthquake_get_feed

count.description: Number of events returned in this page, not the whole feed.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_cursor`: The feed cursor is malformed. `cursor_expired`: The retained generation expired, was evicted, or does not belong to this tenant and feed. `snapshot_too_large`: The feed exceeds retained storage capacity. `feed_unavailable`: USGS feed endpoint returns a 5xx, HTML, or is unreachable. `feed_timeout`: USGS feed endpoint did not answer before the request deadline. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

events.description: Earthquake events for this page, newest first.

alert.description: PAGER estimated impact; null without an assessment or for EMSC.

associated_ids.description: Other network IDs USGS lists for this event, in upstream order; earthquake_get_event accepts them. Absent when USGS lists none, and for EMSC events.

auth.description: Authoritative agency/network code (EMSC auth or USGS net); absent if unpublished.

cdi.description: Maximum DYFI Community Decimal Intensity (0–12); null if uncomputed or unsupported (EMSC).

depth_km.description: Hypocenter depth in km; null if unmeasured.

detail_url.description: URL to fetch the full GeoJSON detail record. Present in USGS list responses.

event_certainty.description: EMSC classification certainty: known (asserted), suspected, unknown, or unreported. Suspected is not confirmed. Absent for USGS and unrecognized EMSC codes.

event_type.description: QuakeML classification (earthquake, quarry blast, explosion, etc.). EMSC codes decode to USGS names; unknown codes pass through verbatim. Certainty is separate. Absent if unpublished; either catalog includes non-tectonic events.

event_url.description: USGS event page URL. Present for USGS events only.

felt.description: DYFI (Did You Feel It?) response count; null if no USGS reports or source has no DYFI (EMSC). Null does not mean unfelt.

magnitude.description: Preferred magnitude; null if not computed (title: "M ?").

magnitude_type.description: Magnitude type (ml, mww, mw, mb, etc.).

mmi.description: Maximum ShakeMap Modified Mercalli intensity (0–12); null without a ShakeMap or for EMSC.

significance.description: USGS significance (0–2000+), combining magnitude, felt reports and PAGER; null if uncomputed or for EMSC.

source_catalog.description: Solution catalog, e.g. EMSC-RTS (real-time, subject to revision). Absent for USGS.

status.description: Review state: automatic (unverified), reviewed (analyst checked), or deleted. Null if unpublished (EMSC); such solutions remain unverified and subject to revision.

tsunami.description: USGS tsunami flag: 1 for large oceanic events, 0 otherwise; null if unpublished (EMSC). Not a warning or evidence of a tsunami; check NOAA tsunami.gov for alerts.

updated.description: ISO 8601 UTC time this record was last updated.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this feed was generated by USGS.

nextCursor.description: Opaque token to pass back as the cursor input for the next page. Present only when more events remain; absent means this was the last page.

notice.description: Guidance when a first-page limit was clamped to 1,000 (requested and applied values), when the feed or cursor position holds no events (a wider window, lower tier, or earthquake_search_events), or when more pages remain (paging with the cursor). Absent when none applies.

totalCount.description: Number of events in the whole feed, across every page.

truncated.description: True when the feed holds more events than this page returned. nextCursor carries the input for the following page.

title: Get USGS Earthquake Feed
